subject.title: fix(voice-call): deliver early TTS via onEarlyText before compaction wait

question: Should this PR require fresh redacted live voice-call proof before merge, or is the linked pre-fix live timing plus maintainer Testbox coverage enough to override the proof gate?
rationale: The code path is now well-covered by focused tests, but the changed behavior is transport timing and duplicate audible playback, which the repository proof policy treats as needing real behavior evidence unless maintainers explicitly override it.

options.title: Require fresh voice-call proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Twilio/VoIP or equivalent live call logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifact showing early speech before compaction and no replay.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the Testbox coverage and linked pre-fix live timing as sufficient despite no after-fix carrier call.

options.title: Pause until a destination exists
options.body: Keep the PR open and linked while waiting for an approved live-call destination or maintainer-owned proof setup.

recommendation.title: Require fresh voice-call proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Twilio/VoIP or equivalent live call logs, terminal output, recording, or linked artifact showing early speech before compaction and no replay.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current rewrite, is assigned, and has the freshest voice-call response-generator history for deciding whether the proof gap can be overridden.
